text: Free software is a matter of liberty, not price. To understand the concept, you should think of 'free' as in 'free speech,' not as in 'free beer'.
I consider that the Golden Rule requires that if I like a program I must share it with other people who like it.
Free software means software that respects users' freedom and community. Roughly, the users have the freedom to run, copy, distribute, study, change and improve the software.
Access to computers, and anything that might teach you something about the way the world works, should be unlimited and total. Always yield to the Hands-On Imperative!
The soldier above all others prays for peace, for it is the soldier who must suffer and bear the deepest wounds and scars of war.
Courage does not always roar. Sometimes courage is the quiet voice at the end of the day saying, 'I will try again tomorrow.'
The greatest danger for most of us is not that our aim is too high and we miss it, but that it is too low and we reach it.
We cannot solve our problems with the same thinking we used when we created them. We must learn to look with fresh eyes.
Do not go where the path may lead, go instead where there is no path and leave a trail for those who will follow.
Do not pray for an easy life, pray for the strength to endure a difficult one. Great characters are forged not in calm waters, but in the tempest of adversity.
Sometimes it is the people no one can imagine anything of who do the things no one can imagine.
